summary: 高風險獨立 code review：確認 Extension 只使用 workspace.fs read/stat/readDirectory 與 clipboard API；無 child_process、shell、repository write、Git、Codex execution 或 external network；Webview strict CSP、typed fail-closed protocol、repo-relative path/credential/raw-log sanitization、schema/legacy compatibility、bounded reads、watcher freshness warning、TreeView/Webview accessibility tokens 與 copy-only governance warning 均符合 approved design。Rollback 為停用或移除 vscode-extension，不需 state migration；command profiles 僅由 DevWeave engine 管理。
